net_revenue.business_scope: Selected site and period, using only the mapped business outcomes export.
net_revenue.detail: No recorded values in this period.

confirmed_revenue.label: Confirmed CRM revenue
confirmed_revenue.formula: Sum recorded sale values for distinct confirmed CRM wins
confirmed_revenue.date_basis: Recorded closing date, using the latest corrected CRM snapshot
confirmed_revenue.definition: Confirmed wins with recorded sale values in the site currency. Coverage is limited to imported records.
confirmed_revenue.detail: 1 confirmed win recorded in the imported CRM.

roas.label: Ad-attributed ROAS
roas.definition: Ad-attributed revenue divided by ad spend from the same ad feed.
roas.business_scope: Selected site and period, using only the mapped ad export or explicitly selected ad subgroup.
roas.detail: ROAS requires ad platform, account, currency, timezone, report level, attribution window, conversion action, and action date basis.

cpl.label: CPL
cpl.definition: Paid spend divided by eligible leads attributable to the same paid scope. Separate ad and business exports cannot establish that match.
cpl.date_basis: Aligned ad and eligible lead reporting dates in a compatible attribution window
cpl.business_scope: Paid acquisition and its attributable leads for the same population and period.
cpl.detail: Requires verified attribution to a matching paid scope.

cpql.label: Cost per qualified lead
cpql.date_basis: Aligned spend and qualification dates in the same attribution window
cpql.definition: Qualified leads must be linked to the same paid population as the spend.
cpql.detail: Requires verified attribution to a matching paid scope.

cac.label: CAC
cac.date_basis: Aligned cost and new-customer dates in the same attribution window
cac.definition: Requires compatible acquisition costs and verified attribution of new customers.
cac.detail: Requires verified attribution to a matching paid scope.
